title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1994-10-03
lineage: MAD > Sony TC-D8 > Optical out > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 1648 > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. Recording & transfer by Andrew F. 02/2015
source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Casio DA-7 > TDK DC4 DAT. Mics on 7-foot stand, end of floor, center & straight back by the hockey wall.

ai_review.summary: An average show that lands in the middle of the road, more suited for hanging out than serious listening.
ai_review.review: The reviewer finds this October‑1994 performance to be a “right‑down‑the‑middle” show – neither a disaster nor a peak Dead night. No specific musical highlights or flaws are mentioned, and the recording itself isn’t described as particularly good or bad, suggesting it’s adequate but not especially compelling for focused listening.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one moderate (3‑star) review that gives a lukewarm impression of both the performance and the recording, leading to an overall below‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit comments on sound clarity or mix; reviewer implies the recording is not particularly engaging for attentive listening.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Described as middle‑of‑the‑road, offering a decent hang‑out vibe but lacking standout moments.
